scenarios.label: Lit Review
scenarios.narration: Step-by-step research-copilot motion. Step 1: hybrid search for seed papers. Steps 2-4: citation_traverse(backward) for the top seeds — 1-hop ancestors. Steps 5-7: citation_traverse(forward) — 1-hop descendants. Step 8: graph_context on the top seed. Steps 9-10: get_paper on the top seeds for synthesis material.
